args.title: Use the configured public URL instead of localhost for password reset links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the BASE_URL constant to use the configured PUBLIC_URL environment variable if available, and fall back to a default value. This prevents the password reset email from containing a localhost URL, which doesn't work in production or for other users. This fixes issue #4201 by ensuring the reset password links direct users to the correct server URL rather than localhost.
